Question: A palindrome is a whole number that reads the same forwards as backwards. If one neglects the colon, certain times displayed on a digital watch are palindromes. Three examples are \(1{:}01,\) \(4{:}44,\) and \(12{:}21.\) How many times during a \(12\)-hour period will be palindromes?
